name: AI search visibility monitor (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude)

parameters.content:
## AI search visibility monitor

Asks the AI answer engines (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) the buyer questions your customers actually type, then checks whether your brand is named or cited. Scores each answer cited(1) / mentioned(0.5) / absent(0), logs every check to Supabase, and prints a panel score you can track over time.

### Why it matters
Buyers ask AI before Google now. If the engines never name you for 'who should I hire', you are invisible where the decision is made. This turns that into a number you can move and chart.

### Setup
1. Add to your n8n environment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY.
2. Create the Supabase table:
create table ai_visibility_log (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  run_at timestamptz default now(),
  brand text, engine text, question text,
  score numeric, cited boolean, mentioned boolean
);
3. Add a Supabase credential and pick it on the log node.
4. Edit brand + questions in Config, then Run. Add a Schedule trigger for a weekly check.

### Dashboard
Chart panel score over time and by engine straight from ai_visibility_log.

Built by nocode.expert. https://nocode.expert

## 1. Configure and ask
Set brand + questions, fan out one item per question, then ask all four engines in parallel.

## 2. Score each answer
Each engine has a parse node: cited if your domain shows up, mentioned if only your name, else absent.

## 3. Log and report
Write every check to Supabase for the dashboard, compute the panel score, print the scorecard.
